name: Reynaldo "buh0"
biography: Rey started out finding bugs and holes in websites at 15. He began attending local infosec meetups in Portland, Oregon—like RainSec and PDX2600—soaking up everything he could. After stumbling across a creepy surveillance device at his high school, he drifted into hardware security and reverse engineering. He’s determined to keep learning and digging deeper.

endorsements.label: Unmasking the Snitch Puck: the creepy IoT surveillance tech in the school bathroom
